final_message: ownerRoleFields now returns `- _MISSING_` (a list item) instead of a bare `_MISSING_` paragraph when no viewpoints apply, so every edit plan template that uses _OWNER_ROLE_VIEWPOINTS_ passes markdownlint MD036. Authoring templates needed no change (_AUTHORING_EXEMPLARS_ already falls back to a list item). Added 8 regression tests (4 maintenance + 4 authoring approaches, no catalog/pm-roles) that lint generated plans for MD036; verified the maintenance tests fail without the fix. Updated ownerRoleFields unit test expectations, CHANGELOG Unreleased, and the PJR-SS72 ticket result section.
